Seven merged PRs since 2026-04-16 added or removed a line containing `lineItems` under `src`. Each date below is the commit date Falkon reports for the squash-merge commit, which I'm treating as the merge date. The repository name needed the full `github.com/openmrs/` form in the search tool, so I used that.

1. **#885**, merged 2026-10-15: `openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/billing-form/billing-form.workspace.tsx` lines 297 and 304 (`bill.lineItems.map`).
2. **#831**, merged 2026-09-17: `openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/billing.resource.test.ts` line 498 (added the `lineItems:(...)` field selector).
3. **#738**, merged 2026-06-04: `openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/discounts/discounts-table.test.tsx` lines 44 and 46, `openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/invoice/invoice.component.tsx` line 83, and `openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/refunds/admin/review-bill-refunds/bill-line-items-table/bill-line-items-table.component.tsx` lines 10 and 13.
4. **#741**, merged 2026-06-02: `openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/invoice/invoice-table.test.tsx` line 436 (added `lineItems: []`).
5. **#744**, merged 2026-05-25: `openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/discounts/admin/review-bill-discounts/review-bill-discounts.modal.tsx` lines 127, 135, 139 and 147 (`lineItems={lineItems}` props).
6. **#732**, merged 2026-05-18: `openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/billable-services/bill-waiver/bill-selection.component.tsx` lines 31, 51 and 71.
7. **#733**, merged 2026-05-20: this one is the least verified. The search reported 29 matches but showed only 5, all in `__mocks__` and `e2e`. The commit does change many `src` files (for example `src/bill-history/bill-history.test.tsx`, `src/invoice/invoice-table.test.tsx`), so I included it, but I did not see a `src` line containing `lineItems` directly.

Excluded:
- **#808** (2026-08-11) changed `lineItems` only under `e2e/`.
- **#783** (2026-06-29) and **#774** (2026-06-18) are translation JSON updates; the matches are in `translations/`.
